summary: Clean up feature schema to match actual generated features (fix validation failures)
rationale: Iterations 2 and 3 failed validation because the feature_schema.json and monotone_constraints.json claimed to have features that weren't actually being generated by the feature pipeline. Specifically, 3 underdog-related features (f1_underdog_upset_potential, f2_underdog_upset_potential, underdog_upset_potential_diff) were added to the schema in iteration 3 but were not properly integrated into the feature extraction pipeline. Comparing the schema (136 claimed) against the actual generated features from iter_1 (133 features) revealed this mismatch. This iteration removes the unimplemented features from the schema to establish a clean baseline where the schema accurately reflects what the code generates. This is a necessary prerequisite before any performance improvements can be properly evaluated and validated.
expected_effect: Expected to fix validation failures by ensuring schema consistency. The schema now accurately reflects the 133 features that are actually generated by the feature pipeline. This will allow the system to train and evaluate models properly, setting a clean baseline for subsequent iterations. No performance improvement is expected from this change alone - it's a schema correction to enable future iterations to proceed.
